topHook: How long do agents take to reply?
_note: Final wording after Red Team (plan/BL-SCRIPTS-2-factcheck.md). Do NOT change VO wording or figures without the lead. Template and state names are the editor's call; 'visual' is the writer's idea.

scenes.vo: [curious] When a buyer asks about a home online, how long until an agent writes back? In one US study, the agents who replied took five point three hours on average.
scenes.label: average reply time (agents who replied)
scenes.visual: Message bubble flies to an agency; a big clock

scenes.vo: And forty-eight percent of buyer inquiries never got a reply from an agent.
scenes.label: no reply from an agent

scenes.vo: That's from a study done for the brokerage Weichert.
scenes.label: US study, 2013–14 (WAV Group for Weichert)
scenes.visual: Map of US states with pins

scenes.vo: [lowered] Now compare that with research on sales leads in general.
scenes.visual: Camera pulls back to a city of shops

scenes.vo: Reply within an hour, and you're nearly seven times likelier to qualify the lead than if you wait even an hour longer.
scenes.label: likelier to qualify the lead (HBR 2011)
scenes.visual: One shop lights up within the hour

scenes.vo: [quiet] An instant first reply means buyers don't wait in silence. So next time someone asks you:
